items.title: Chancellor's Catalyst Awards Ignite Research in Humanities, Social Sciences
items.summary: By Jody Murray, UC Merced August 12, 2026 The site of Mariposa County Gold Rush town Agua Fria will be the subject of an archeological study by UC Merced faculty and students. Digging for stories in a Gold Rush town that vanished in flames 170 years ago. Pinging brainwaves for reactions from sentences that slide between Spanish and English.
